turns.question: How many customers did anything on our site or in the CRM in the week up to 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: 9 engaged customers (distinct customers with any site or CRM action) in the 7 days ending 3 October 2026 (27 September to 3 October). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
